job_statement: When evaluating CI/CD solutions for Kubernetes-based applications, I want to understand what OpenShift Pipelines is and its cloud-native approach, so I can determine if it fits my automation needs.
related_jobs: Understand OpenShift Pipelines concepts; Understand key features
desired_outcomes: Minimize time to evaluate CI/CD options; Ensure the solution is cloud-native and Kubernetes-compatible; Reduce uncertainty about portability across Kubernetes distributions

job_statement: When evaluating OpenShift Pipelines capabilities, I want to understand its key features including serverless execution, decentralization support, and OpenShift integration, so I can assess whether it meets my architectural requirements.

job_statement: When designing CI/CD workflows, I want to understand how Tasks define reusable units of work with sequentially executed steps, so I can create modular and maintainable pipeline components.

notes: User story focused on understanding the Task resource as a building block. Includes concrete example with apply-manifests task.
